preliminaryValidation: Early synthetic runs caught fixture compile, query, native popup-action and hit-target issues; corrected runs supersede them.

The first full candidate run passed 74/75; a FilterResize fixture incorrectly assumed contextual Command-K was archive-wide. It now explicitly invokes Search everything without weakening geometry assertions.

The first live candidate rejected valid persisted v1 terminal indexes. The archive was preserved. The shared validation guard was corrected, persisted reopen/backup fixtures were added, the app was rebuilt/reinstalled, and the final full run passes.
Failed and invalidated build/test records remain diagnostic evidence, not approved results.
limitations: Search covers saved DaBin captures and workspace notes, not every Mac file or semantic meanings.
Captures use original captureDay; scratchpads use their last edited date. A week is seven calendar days ending on the chosen day.
PDF extraction is limited to 100 pages; extraction to 300000 characters; text/RTF/DOCX input and DOCX expanded package to 12 MiB.
DOCX main-body paragraphs and tables only; no headers, footnotes, comments, embedded-image OCR, legacy DOC, Pages or other Office internal text.
No exact PDF-page navigation or external-document hit highlighting.
The personal archive was not independently byte-inventoried; local indexing may update its text cache. Installer deployment changes only app bundles.
A backed-up older app bundle is not proof that it can read a subsequently upgraded v2 index.
Assertions include rendering and choreography measurements, not independent user journeys. Native own-process AX/controls and offscreen renders are not recruited-user or hardware-input testing.
macOS 14/Intel runtime behavior, signed distribution, notarization and App Store approval remain unverified. The previous 0.4.19 Store audit is historical.
